title: statusline r18 UX: accept flag versus existing statusLine unstated
description: Round 18. Lens: ux, lower confidence (validator: DR). Defect: the flag's guard is scoped to failed probes; its interaction with a successful probe finding an existing entry is resolvable only by construction, never stated or fixtured — automation could overwrite a customized statusLine. Citations verified: contract:162, :173, :187. Proposed: resolved-candidate (the flag equals a pre-confirmed offer and the offer never fires against an existing entry — stated; statusLine-present-with-flag fixture refuses identically). Also folding the coverage observation: the new statusline versioned-data artifacts join the versioned-data inventory line.
